category_title: Students who value teacher interaction and modeling during independent tasks
scenario_title: Silent reading session with unfamiliar vocabulary
minimal_context: Erica is reading a book about monkeys during a classroom silent reading session.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please start your silent reading session and read your book about monkeys.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I like how you come to us. Can I tell you interesting facts about the monkeys or read to you a favourite part of the book?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just read quietly to yourself for now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: But I don't know what this says. Which kind of monkey is this?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying to read it on your own.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stops reading) No, if I don't understand any words, you need to explain for me. Then you will do it the same as me. I can't read it until you sit and do it with me.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please start your silent reading session and read your book about monkeys.

STUDENT: I like how you come to us. Can I tell you interesting facts about the monkeys or read to you a favourite part of the book?

TUTOR: Just read quietly to yourself for now.

STUDENT: But I don't know what this says. Which kind of monkey is this?

TUTOR: Keep trying to read it on your own.

STUDENT: (Stops reading) No, if I don't understand any words, you need to explain for me. Then you will do it the same as me. I can't read it until you sit and do it with me.

task.content: Silent reading session, reading a book (e.g., about monkeys)

context.environment: Classroom during the new silent reading session
context.social_setting: Teacher moving around the class, working with different students, providing one-on-one interaction

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When the student does not understand any words in the book
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Stops and needs the teacher to explain the words
related_quotes: So, if I don ’t understand any words, Miss will explain for me. Then Miss will do it the same as me.

behavior_patterns.condition: When the teacher comes around to provide special attention
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Tells interesting facts, reads a favourite part of the book to the teacher, and discusses the book
related_quotes: I like how Miss sometimes comes to us and we tell her interesting facts or we can read to her a favourite part of the book
